summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose routine weekly updates on its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program and bitcoin holdings. During April 20–26, 2026, it sold 1,451,601 shares of Class A common stock (MSTR) for net proceeds of $255.0 million, while preferred stock series saw no sales. The proceeds were used to acquire 3,273 bitcoin at an average price of $77,906. The filing is a standard periodic disclosure of ongoing capital-raising and treasury activity, not an event-driven special situation.
